usageNotes: Use this to create a named view in PDM, which acts as a filtered subset of resources visible in the dashboard. The 'id' must be unique across all views; creating a view with a duplicate id will fail. If neither 'include' nor 'exclude' rules are provided, set 'include-all' to true to make the view capture all resources by default.

examples.summary: Create a view that includes all resources and scopes it to a named group

tips: Use the 'digest' param (SHA256 of the current config) to guard against concurrent modifications when multiple operators may be updating views simultaneously.
'include' and 'exclude' take filter rule arrays — fetch an existing view first to understand the expected rule format before constructing them.
The 'id' field follows a restricted character set (alphanumeric, dots, hyphens, underscores; 2–32 chars); names like 'my view' with spaces will be rejected.
Returns null on success — verify the view was created by calling GET /config/views/{id} afterward.
